about.summary: Riverside Heights is a co-educational day school where 1,200 learners from nursery to grade 12 grow into confident, compassionate and capable young people.
body: Founded by a group of parents and educators in 1998, Riverside Heights began with 60 students in a rented house by the river. Today our 8-acre green campus is home to modern science labs, a 20,000-book library, sports grounds and a performing arts centre.

Our teaching blends a rigorous national curriculum with project-based learning, so students learn to ask good questions, work in teams and apply what they know. Small class sizes mean every learner is known, challenged and supported.
Beyond academics, we believe character is built on the playing field, the stage and in service to the community. Every student takes part in clubs, sports and an annual service project.
about.mission: To nurture lifelong learners who think critically, act with integrity and serve their communities.
about.vision: To be a leading school where every child discovers their potential and the confidence to pursue it.

principal.name: Dr. Meera Joshi
principal.title: Principal, M.Ed., Ph.D.
message: Welcome to Riverside Heights. For over two decades our school has been a place where children feel safe to be curious, to make mistakes and to discover what they love.

Our dedicated teachers combine academic excellence with genuine care. We measure success not only by examination results, of which we are proud, but by the kindness, resilience and leadership our students show.
I warmly invite you to visit our campus, meet our community and see learning in action.

news.title: Riverside students win national science olympiad
news.excerpt: Our grade 10 team took gold in chemistry and silver in physics at the National Science Olympiad.
body: We are thrilled to share that our grade 10 olympiad team won gold in chemistry and silver in physics at this year's National Science Olympiad, competing against 140 schools.
The team trained after school for six months under the guidance of Ms. Sunita Karki and Mr. Anil Shrestha. Congratulations to every student who took part.

news.title: New robotics and innovation lab opens
news.excerpt: A new lab with 3D printers, robotics kits and maker space opened for students in grades 4 to 12.
body: Our new robotics and innovation lab opened this month with 3D printers, laser cutters and 40 robotics kits.
Students from grades 4 to 12 will use the space for coding classes, the robotics club and independent projects.

admissions.intro: We welcome applications for nursery to grade 11. Our admissions team is happy to guide you through every step.

steps.title: Enquire or visit
steps.description: Fill in the enquiry form or join a Saturday campus tour.

steps.title: Submit the application
steps.description: Complete the application form with the required documents.

steps.title: Assessment & interview
steps.description: Age-appropriate assessment for grades 1 and above, and a friendly family interview.

steps.title: Offer & enrolment
steps.description: Receive your offer letter and confirm the seat by paying the admission fee.

requirements: Previous school report card and transfer certificate

faqs.question: What is the student–teacher ratio?
faqs.answer: 1:12 in the early years and an average of 1:20 from grade 1 upwards.

faqs.question: Do you provide school transport?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPS-tracked buses cover 25 routes across the valley, each with a trained attendant.

faqs.question: Are scholarships available?
faqs.answer: We offer merit and need-based scholarships covering up to 100% of tuition for grades 6 to 12.

faqs.question: What are the school hours?
faqs.answer: Classes run from 8:30 AM to 3:30 PM, Sunday to Friday. Clubs run until 4:30 PM.
